时长 2:25:51 句数 1363 术语 159 章节 20 上次听到 --:--

摘要

观看后，学习者将通过从零构建 micrograd（一个基于 Value 对象表达式图、用链式法则自动求梯度的微型自动求导引擎）理解反向传播的底层原理。他们还会看到如何用这些梯度实现神经元、多层感知机、损失函数和梯度下降训练循环，并了解 micrograd 与 PyTorch 的异同。

After watching, learners will understand how backpropagation works under the hood by building micrograd, a tiny autograd engine that constructs expression graphs of Value objects and computes gradients automatically using the chain rule. They will also see how those gradients power a neuron, MLP, loss function, and a gradient-descent training loop, and how micrograd compares to PyTorch.
